title: Coolberries
description: The most delicious and cool berries. Try to collect them all. It will be delicious! Combine similar berries, fruits and various sweets. If you like interesting puzzles, logic games, nice design and sweets, then you will definitely enjoy this game!
instructions: Controls on mobile devices - Swipe across the screen in the desired direction Mouse control - Hold down the right mouse button move in the desired direction and release the mouse button Keyboard control - W A S D keys or arrow keys
